svg.title: Logfire MCP: query traces and telemetry through Logfire's MCP server
svg.desc: Inside your agent, the LogfireMCP capability connects to Logfire's hosted MCP server, US region by default or EU with LOGFIRE_EU_MCP_URL, sending the API key as a bearer token. The model sees the server's tools under the logfire_ prefix, such as logfire_query_run. The capability also adds guidance to the agent's instructions: the current UTC hour, that queries cover a short time window, that links are made only when asked, and the logfire_ prefix.
